blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus crossed to the far side of the Sea of Galilee, a wide lake also called Tiberias. He was not alone for long. People had heard about the sick being healed, and a huge crowd followed him around the water.

verses.text: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

verses.text: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: It was almost time for the Passover, the great feast of the year.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: From the hillside, Jesus looked up and saw the crowd still coming.

verses.text: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus asked to test him. He already knew what he would do. Philip looked out over the crowd and counted the cost in his head.

verses.text: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

segments.speaker: philip
segments.text: Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: It is easy to understand why Philip felt that way. We look at what is in our hands, and it seems far too small for the need in front of us.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Then Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, spoke up. He had found a boy in the crowd who had some food with him.

verses.text: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

segments.speaker: andrew
segments.text: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Five loaves of barley bread and two little fish. Barley bread was plain food, the bread of ordinary people. It was one boy's lunch, and a mountainside full of hungry people.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus did not send anyone away.

verses.text: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Thousands of people sat down on the soft green grass and waited.

verses.text: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: No one had to hold back or worry that the food would run out. Everyone ate until they were full.

verses.text: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: There was more left over than they had started with.

verses.text: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The people looked at those twelve full baskets and began to talk about the one who had fed them.

verses.text: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said,

segments.speaker: men
segments.text: This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The boy only had five small loaves and two fish. Philip only saw an impossible bill to pay. Yet when that small meal was placed in Jesus' hands, he thanked God and made it more than enough. That is where the story leaves us, with a quiet hillside and twelve full baskets. Nothing is too small when it is placed in his hands.

first_reader.note: Written by Claude in the landing session, then Claude's pastor and cultural read.

pastor.note: Faithful to John 6:1-14; the boy's lunch and the twelve baskets as given; no promise of provision to the listener.

cultural.note: Plain, warm; barley bread named as ordinary people's food without a poverty stereotype.
